name: Grants
overview: The biblical concept of grants reveals God's generous provision to believers, demonstrated supremely in His giving of the only begotten Son for eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16). Additionally, God grants spiritual strength through His Spirit to empower the inner man (Ephesians 3:16), and promises the victorious believer the privilege of sharing in Christ's throne, reflecting the reward for overcoming (Revelation 3:21). These passages collectively emphasize that grants from God are both spiritual empowerments and eternal rewards, grounded in His glory and grace.
